name: session-activity
description: Status line showing elapsed time, tool calls, files edited and lines changed this session, with per-session history

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the elapsed time on the status line is refreshed

showTime.title: Show elapsed time
showTime.description: Include the elapsed session time on the status line

showTools.title: Show tool calls
showTools.description: Include the tool call count on the status line

showFiles.title: Show files edited
showFiles.description: Include the edited file count on the status line

showLines.title: Show lines changed
showLines.description: Include lines added and removed on the status line

historySize.title: Sessions kept in history
historySize.description: How many past sessions /activity history remembers
